content.title: Karat Packaging (NASDAQ:KRT) Posts Q3 Sales In Line With Estimates
content.summary: Foodservice packaging supplier Karat Packaging (NASDAQ:KRT) met Wall Streets revenue expectations in Q3 CY2025, with sales up 10.4% year on year to $124.5 million.
